settings.headline: Get an instant LED screen estimate
settings.intro: Tell us the size, show us where it's going, and download your estimate as a PDF. We'll even send you a free photo-realistic image of the screen on your building.
settings.terms: This is an estimate based on the information you provided. Final pricing is confirmed after a free site survey. Prices exclude VAT unless stated. Electrical supply and planning permission are not included.
settings.thankYou: Thanks, your estimate is downloading. One of our team will be in touch within one working day.
